title: TERE4AI v2 Layer 2 normative statement
description: Machine-readable contract for NormativeStatement nodes (docs/architecture.md Section 3, grounded in Institutional Grammar: actor = Attribute, deontic_type and modal = Deontic, action/object/conditions = Aim). An Article is not one requirement; each extracted norm is one node. No norm exists without a source span, and no norm is accepted without a judge verdict.

modal.description: The literal modal signal in the text

actorRole.description: Canonical actor vocabulary (Section 3); extend only via canonicalize/, never ad hoc

requirementType.description: DEC-19: three of the requirements type attribute examples of ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148:2018 clause 5.2.8.3

targetSystemCategory.description: DEC-21: the Act's own scope terms, one per part of its rules: Chapter I (any_ai_system), Chapter II (prohibited_ai_practice), Chapter III with Annexes III and IV and Articles 72 and 73 (high_risk_ai_system), Chapter IV (article_50_ai_system)

source_node_id.description: Operative Layer 1 node (article, paragraph, point, annex item). NEVER a recital (Section 1).

actor_explicit.description: Actor as literally named in the text, null when absent

actor_inference_source_node_id.description: Required when actor_inferred is set, e.g. eu-ai-act:article-16 (provider duties)

target_system_category.description: DEC-21: the part of the Act's rules the norm belongs to, named by the category of AI systems those rules govern; not the system a single paragraph talks about (the addressee stays in the actor fields). Set by rule from the norm's source Article or Annex (src/tere4ai/extract_norms/target_system_category.py), never by a model; null only for a source unit outside the rule table.

requirement_type.description: DEC-19: set only on an operator obligation or prohibition in a requirement group; null otherwise, shown "not an operator requirement". Optional so a norm from a build before DEC-19, or a reply that omits it, is never dropped for it.

judge_type_agrees.description: DEC-19: whether the extraction judge agrees with requirement_type; null when the judge recorded no view or the type is null. Never changes judge_verdict.

judge_requirement_type.description: DEC-19: the extraction judge's view of the type (the agreed type, or its own when it disagrees); null when no view was recorded.
